page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio provide predictable, non-shared compute resources suitable for enterprise workloads that demand consistent performance without the overhead of virtualization-induced resource contention.

Given its balanced resource profile, the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is designed for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, middle-tier application servers, and moderate database workloads. The lack of integrated GPUs and local storage makes it less suitable for hardware-accelerated machine learning or high-IOPS local caching tasks, but highly effective for distributed systems and standard business applications.
